01 · About the venue

A neighbourhood banquet address in Baghmugaliya Extension

Vairaj Banquet & Rooms is a family-run function venue on 80 Feet Road, just off Hoshangabad Road — built for the kind of celebration this part of Bhopal actually hosts: engagement, sagai, marriage, reception, birthdays, kitty parties, havan and community functions.

Two air-conditioned halls let you match the room to the guest list: a compact hall for 100–150 people, and a larger hall for up to 250 seated or 400 floating. Sixteen rooms in the same building mean outstation family can stay on-site instead of driving home after the vidaai.

  • Catering your way — in-house veg menus from ₹360 per plate, non-veg from ₹750, or bring your own caterer.
  • Havan, baraat & overnight functions — all permitted, with a pre-function area for guests and décor arranged by the venue.
  • Rated 4.7 / 5 by 58+ users on The Wedding Company and 4.1 on BookEventz — praised for ambience, hospitality and cleanliness.
  • Budget-first, not budget-looking — AC halls, chandelier lighting and 30-car parking at neighbourhood-venue pricing.

How booking works

Five simple steps to your function day

  • 1 · Call or WhatsApp us
    Share your date, function type and rough guest count. We check hall availability and tell you straight away.
  • 2 · Visit the hall
    See both halls, walk the floor, check parking and the pre-function area — a real look, not a brochure.
  • 3 · Pick your menu & décor
    Choose veg (from ₹360) or non-veg (from ₹750) menus, counters, and stage décor. Bring your own caterer if you prefer.
  • 4 · Written quotation
    You get hall rent, per-plate menu, décor and extras listed line by line — no lump-sum surprises.
  • 5 · Confirm & celebrate
    Advance as per venue policy freezes the date. On the day, our team handles seating, service, parking and baraat.

    Everything a family function needs on one premises

    Air-conditioned halls, a stage to decorate, a pre-function area, parking for thirty cars and sixteen rooms upstairs — so nobody has to leave early or shuttle between locations.

    Two Air-conditioned Halls

    A compact hall for 100–150 guests and a larger hall for up to 250 seated or 400 floating — both with stage space and buffet counters.

    Baraat & 30-Car Parking

    Baraat entry is permitted on the premises with parking for thirty cars — useful on 80 Feet Road where roadside space is scarce.

    Sixteen air-conditioned rooms with attached bathrooms in the same building — for outstation family, bride or groom side guests.

    On the function day

    How the venue runs your function

    A typical booking covers a full day-slot or evening-slot. Setup starts hours earlier — stage, entrance décor, seating and buffet counters. Guests arriving early are received in the pre-function area instead of standing on the road, and the floor is reset between haldi, baraat and dinner if you have more than one function the same day.

    • Seating layoutsRound tables, seated rows, cluster or floating as per guest countyour choice
    • DécorStage, entrance arch, floral and backdrop arrangements by the venueavailable
    • Service teamStewards for buffet and table service during the functionincluded
    • Rooms for guestsBlock bookings for family at the same addresson request

    For overnight events and multi-function days, inform us at the time of booking so the floor and staff rota can be planned.

    11 · FAQ & policies

    Questions families ask us before booking

    Our larger air-conditioned hall — Vairaj Banquet Hall — can seat about 250 guests and hold up to 400 in floating (standing / buffet) arrangement. The smaller Vairaj Party Hall is designed for 100 to 150 guests. For engagements, sagai and small receptions of 100–150 people, the party hall is usually the better fit and the most economical.

    Both work. Our in-house kitchen serves vegetarian menus from ₹360 per plate and non-vegetarian from ₹750 per plate, including buffet counters and service staff. If you already have a caterer you trust, external catering is allowed at this venue — you arrange the food and we provide the space, counters and coordination.

    Yes. Havan and pooja are permitted in the hall or on the premises, and overnight wedding functions are allowed. Satvik menus — prepared without onion and garlic — can be arranged by our kitchen for religious functions. Please tell us at booking time if your function runs past midnight so the staff rota and lighting can be planned.

    Advance terms are decided by the venue based on your date, hall and menu selection — our booking desk will tell you the exact amount and the cancellation terms in writing. Every booking receives a proper invoice. We recommend confirming early for dates in the wedding season, when the weekends fill up months in advance.

    Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can be requested subject to availability — the front desk is attended round the clock, so late arrivals are not a problem. Please carry original photo ID for all adult guests.

    Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence and Voter ID are accepted. The primary guest must be at least 18 years old. This property is listed with a house policy of not permitting unmarried couples, and local-ID bookings are accepted at the desk's discretion — please confirm the current policy with our booking desk at +91 98935 50505 before you travel, so there is no confusion at check-in.

    Yes — on-site parking for about 30 cars, and baraat entry is permitted on the premises. On function days our team guides vehicles in and out; if you expect more than 30 vehicles, tell us in advance and we will arrange the overflow plan for 80 Feet Road with your family's volunteers.

    Sixteen rooms in two categories. Deluxe Rooms are 144 sq ft (13 m²) with a double bed, starting at ₹1,627 per night plus taxes. Super Deluxe Rooms are 160 sq ft (15 m²) with an attached balcony, starting at ₹1,899 per night. All rooms have attached bathrooms, air-conditioning and housekeeping; up to four guests can be accommodated per room.

    Raja Bhoj International Airport is about 23.5 km by road. Bhopal Junction and Rani Kamlapati (Habibganj) stations are roughly 13–15 km, and the city centre is about 10.5 km away. Aashima Mall in Baghmugaliya is a short drive. Please treat these as approximate road distances — 80 Feet Road traffic varies through the day.

    The hall, stage, buffet and venue photographs are actual photographs of Vairaj Banquet.
